name: drive-stop
description: Brakes + steering (spec/drive.json) after the landing: pure MPC with the brake / steer channels (drive: true) and the land objective's drive terms (kerb crash, kerb margin, distance, stop-before-the-kerb), task escape-land-stop (land softly, then stop within 8 s without touching a kerb), 6 presets x 3 seeds; baseline: the same MPC without drive channels. Soft-body counterpart: tools/flight/calib/accept.mjs sets=stop.
